name: Representative Actions Directive
impact_assessment: SWD(2018) 96 (joint impact assessment for the New Deal for Consumers)
evidence_rating: ex-ante only: applies since June 2023; no evaluation yet
summary: National rules transposing the Directive apply to representative actions brought since 25 June 2023, and several Member States transposed late. No Commission evaluation exists yet and no study measuring how many collective actions it has enabled was found.

indicators.objective: Applies since 25 June 2023; Commission evaluation due no earlier than 2028

literature.citation: European Commission (2018), Impact Assessment accompanying the New Deal for Consumers proposals, SWD(2018) 96
literature.title: Impact Assessment accompanying the New Deal for Consumers proposals
literature.headline: Joint impact assessment for the Omnibus Directive and the Representative Actions Directive; collective redress expected to improve consumers' access to justice in mass-harm cases
literature.summary_plain: The Commission expected EU-wide collective actions to make it easier for consumers to get redress when many are harmed at once.
